evidence.quote: Rods, 10 mm in diameter and 80 mm long, were prepared by arc-melting high-purity (> 99.9%) Cr, Mn, Fe, Co and Ni in an argon atmosphere.
single crystals were grown by the Bridgman method by re-melting the arc-melted rods in an alumina crucible in vacuum and pulling (directionally solidifying) at a rate of 40 mm/h.
The single crystals were annealed at 1373 K for 96 hours, followed by water quenching.
They were prepared by annealing at 1273 K for 1 hour after cold-rolling of arc-melted ingots to 90% reduction in thickness.
